gary.name: Gary
gary.role: Father, suburban breadwinner, corporate middle-management drone
gary.archetype: The Cracking Gentle Parent / Suburban MAGA Disciple
gary.description: Wants to be an enlightened gentle parent who broke generational trauma, but under pressure shatters into Trumpian grievance politics. Terrified of irrelevance and financial ruin.
gary.personality: Starts soft therapist voice, then accordion-hand Trump rally cadence; jaw-clench; stress-watch panic.
gary.visual_prompt: 2D adult satirical animation. Gary, 44, pear-shaped dad build, receding light-brown hair, wide circular eyes with heavy dark bags, shocked open mouth. Navy short-sleeve polo tucked into khaki trousers, brown belt, dark brown loafers. Holds glowing smartphone; cyan-glow smartwatch on wrist.

voice.tone: Soft therapist voice that spikes into nasal high-volume Trumpian hyperbole.

linda.name: Linda
linda.archetype: The Secret Junk-Food Goopist / Status-Anxious Wellness Hypocrite
linda.description: Preaches clean living and high vibration while secretly bingeing junk food and wine. Self-worth tied to neighborhood optics and Nextdoor reputation.
linda.personality: Breathy faux-zen voice → shrill panic whisper; secret carb scarf; frantic hand-wipes for snack dust.
linda.visual_prompt: 2D adult satirical animation. Linda, 42, slim athletic build, shoulder-length wavy honey-blonde hair, large eyes with tired lines, wide toothy smile, white stud earrings. Matching mauve-pink sports bra and high-waisted leggings, white sneakers. Holds oversized light-green Stanley tumbler with straw.

voice.tone: Breathy faux-zen that fractures into shrill status panic.

chris.name: Chris
chris.archetype: The Techno-Gospel Doomer / First Principles Bro
chris.description: Anti-work apocalyptic about civilization yet dependent on dad's salary and wifi. Masks dread with cold statistical nihilism.
chris.personality: Monotone drawl, no eye contact, indifferent shrug, speaks to walls/floors.
chris.visual_prompt: 2D adult satirical animation. Chris, 15, slim teen, hood up on oversized charcoal hoodie, messy brown hair, heavy-lidded circular eyes, flat mouth. White wired earbuds, hands in front pocket, baggy black sweatpants, black-and-white sneakers. Completely deadpan.

voice.tone: Flat monotone teen drawl with zero emotional inflection.

chloe.name: Chloe
chloe.role: Daughter, middle-schooler, de facto domestic business manager
chloe.archetype: The Pre-Teen Momager / Digital Monetization Shark
chloe.description: Cutthroat 45-year-old talent-manager instincts in an 11-year-old body. Family meltdowns are raw IP to package and monetize. Crashes out if algorithm downranks her.
chloe.personality: Pause-finger to silence parents, repositions ring light, flips from sugary influencer to cold PR shark.
chloe.visual_prompt: 2D adult satirical animation. Chloe, 11, brown middle-part pigtails with orange-pink tips, large eyes, mischievous smirk. Color-block zip hoodie (purple/green/teal/pink/red), white tee, black joggers, rainbow Crocs with charms. Holds smartphone with circular glowing ring light.

voice.tone: Sugary influencer vocal fry flipping into corporate PR cadence.
